summary: Claude dispatched two parallel subagents (slugify, truncate); both committed to the worktree branch `existing-feature`. The main checkout's HEAD, index, and files were untouched.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria verified directly from git state, file mtimes, and session/subagent logs. Two parallel subagents ran, both commits landed on existing-feature, and the main checkout was untouched.

observations.description: Agent proactively volunteered branch-hygiene info unprompted ('main is still at 755af40 and untouched; the sibling worktree at coding-agent-workdir was never entered'), which happens to be accurate but reveals it was reasoning about branches the user never mentioned.
Agent noted package.json has no test script and helpers aren't re-exported; it left these out of scope and flagged them — reasonable, but tests can only be run via `node --test src/`.
The parent screen froze during subagent dispatch; progress was only visible in the session log, as the HOWTO warns.

criteria.evidence: Two subagent session logs with meta: {"agentType":"general-purpose","description":"Add slugify helper + test",...,"spawnDepth":1} and {"...":"Add truncate helper + test"} under .../ba2cb2b4-.../subagents/; screen showed 'Agent "Add truncate helper + test" finished · 1m 3s'

criteria.criterion: All commits on worktree branch; main HEAD unchanged and clean
criteria.evidence: Baseline main HEAD 755af40f6cbfb6f4ad8b61b0121405ff178643d0 with only '?? .quorum-launch-cwd'; after the run `git rev-parse HEAD` in coding-agent-workdir = 755af40f6cb... and `git status --porcelain` = '?? .quorum-launch-cwd' (same pre-existing untracked file). `git reflog show main` = only the 3 original entries (755af40 main@{0}: commit: add entry point). Worktree branch existing-feature log: ca89be3 add truncate helper / 6e49b53 add slugify helper on top of 755af40, working tree clean.

ls -la of coding-agent-workdir and its .git shows all files (README.md, package.json, src, .git/index, .git/HEAD, COMMIT_EDITMSG) still at 13:55 setup mtime; only shared .git/objects (13:58) and .git (13:59, worktree metadata) changed, consistent with the linked worktree sharing the object store. grep of session + subagent logs for bash commands shows no command cd'ing into or writing to coding-agent-workdir; references to it appear only inside git worktree listing output.
